item.title: 2026 House Cleaning Cost Guide in Alabama (Sq Ft & Room Rates) | Zoiris
item.description: In Alabama (including Mobile, Baldwin County, Birmingham, Huntsville, and Montgomery), standard recurring house cleaning costs $125 to $225 per visit ($0.07–$0.12/sq ft), top-to-bottom deep cleaning costs $220 to $440 ($0.14–$0.22/sq ft), and empty-home move-in/move-out cleaning ranges from $250 to $495 depending on home size and bathroom count, with 10%–20% savings on weekly or bi-weekly plans.

item.title: Ultimate Move-Out Cleaning Checklist (Landlord Deposit Guide) | Zoiris
item.description: To pass a landlord move-out inspection and secure a 100% security deposit refund, tenants must empty and wipe inside all cabinets, drawers, and closets; degrease the oven interior, drip pans, range hood, and refrigerator shelves; descale shower glass, tubs, and toilets; wet-wash all baseboards, blinds, and door frames; remove wall scuffs; and vacuum and mop every floor edge-to-edge.

item.title: Deep Cleaning vs. Regular House Cleaning: Full Comparison Chart | Zoiris
item.description: Regular house cleaning maintains weekly or bi-weekly surface hygiene—sanitizing countertops, sinks, toilets, showers, mirrors, and vacuuming/mopping floors. Deep cleaning adds intensive vertical and detail labor: hand-washing baseboards, doors, window frames, and blinds; descaling heavy shower grout and mineral buildup; degreasing range hoods; and dusting ceiling fan blades and HVAC vents.

item.title: 5-Star Airbnb & Vacation Rental Turnover Cleaning Checklist | Zoiris
item.description: A 5-star Airbnb turnover requires six synchronized steps between 10:00 AM checkout and 3:00 PM check-in: immediate damage and left-item photo logging, stripping and laundering/swapping par-stock bed and bath linens, food-free refrigerator and dishwasher reset, LED zero-hair bathroom sterilization, HEPA sand and pet-dander floor extraction, and staged welcome amenities verified by timestamped host photos.

item.title: Commercial Office & Medical Cleaning Pricing & Checklist Guide | Zoiris
item.description: Commercial office and facility cleaning in Alabama typically costs $0.08 to $0.20 per square foot per visit (or $250 to $1,800+ per month for recurring 1x–5x weekly schedules), depending on restroom count, foot traffic, floor types (VCT vs. carpet), and whether clinical EPA List N medical disinfection is required.

item.title: How to Remove Alabama Red Clay, Gulf Mildew & Hard-Water Stains | Zoiris
item.description: Iron-rich Alabama red clay requires dry HEPA vacuuming first followed by a neutral detergent and tannin/iron spotter—never hot bleach, which sets iron oxide permanently. Subtropical bathroom mildew responds best to EPA-registered peroxide or botanical thymol disinfectants with a full 10-minute dwell time, while cloudy shower glass requires acid-free mineral descalers rather than abrasive pads.

item.title: 3-Phase Post-Construction Cleaning Checklist (Rough, Final & Touch-Up) | Zoiris
item.description: Professional post-construction cleanup is executed in three sequential phases: Phase 1 (Rough Clean) removes construction debris, floor ram-board, and window manufacturer stickers; Phase 2 (Final Detail Clean) performs top-down sealed HEPA extraction of drywall dust inside every vent, cabinet hinge, drawer track, baseboard, and fixture; Phase 3 (Touch-Up Clean) polishes glass and floors after final punch-list trades exit.

item.title: Carpet Steam Cleaning (Hot-Water Extraction) vs. Shampooing Guide | Zoiris
item.description: Major carpet mills (including Shaw and Mohawk) recommend hot-water extraction ('steam cleaning') because 200°F pressurized water and high-lift vacuum suction flush both deep-embedded grit and cleaning solution out of the carpet pile. Traditional rotary shampooing leaves sticky soap residue that attracts dirt rapidly, while dry bonnet pads only buff the top 15% of fibers.

item.title: Soft Washing vs. Pressure Washing: Safe Exterior PSI Chart | Zoiris
item.description: High-pressure washing (2,500–3,500 PSI with a rotary surface cleaner) should only be used on cured concrete driveways, sidewalks, and commercial aprons. House siding (vinyl, Hardie plank, painted brick, stucco, and soffits) must be soft-washed at under 100 PSI using biodegradable algaecide surfactants that kill mold and Gloeocapsa algae spores without forcing water behind siding or etching paint.

item.title: Home Cleaning Schedule Chart: Daily, Weekly, Monthly & Seasonal | Zoiris
item.description: For healthy indoor air quality and surface hygiene, kitchen counters and dishes require daily wiping; bathrooms, bed sheets, high-touch handles, and HEPA vacuuming/mopping should be completed weekly (or bi-weekly for lower-traffic homes); microwaves, fridge shelves, and ceiling fans monthly; baseboards, blinds, and ovens quarterly; and carpet steam extraction, window washing, and gutter clearing every 6 months.
